dct_description_sm: Refers to a set of strip maps showing roads in California.
Features "Coast route to San Francisco" and "Inland route to San Francisco."
This copy has checkmarks noting certain maps, in pencil.
To find series maps, search for "Belongs to a series of strip maps showing roads in California."
